BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Genetics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
